label: Pen Register Act — ECPA Title III Original Enactment
source: Electronic Communications Privacy Act of 1986, Pub. L. 99-508, Title III
provisions_enacted: 18 U.S.C. §3121 — prohibition on pen register/trap and trace device use without court order
